{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows and basic info
types = sales.dtypes
head = sales.head()
shape = sales.shape

# Check for missing values
missing = sales.isnull().sum()

# Check the unique values in the 'channel' column
channels = sales['channel'].unique()

# Check the 'revenue' column
revenue_summary = sales['revenue'].describe()

# Output
print('Data types:\n', types)
print('\nFirst 5 rows:\n', head)
print('\nShape:', shape)
print('\nMissing values:\n', missing)
print('\nUnique channels:', channels)
print('\nRevenue summary:\n', revenue_summary)"}
